thread:
tom: Quick follow-up from the PM: the KV-cache regression showed up again under bursty traffic. We need concrete tests and a short remediation plan so this doesn't recur.

maya: Agreed. My shortlist: tiny unit for KV (serialization/ordering), a small nightly load job that ramps to the observed threshold, and a focused prompt/conv set that exercises prefix reuse.

sara: Sounds good. Can you paste 2-3 representative prompts so I can wire them into the eval runner?

tom: Paste below — keep them compact so CI stays quick.
1) "Hello" + repeat token pattern that forces cache reuse.
2) Multi-turn where earlier user messages are re-referenced after 40 tokens.
3) Short system + many identical tokens in prompt prefix.

kevin: Reproducer notes: the mismatch spikes around 7k rps, avg seq ~75-90 tokens. Local loop reproduced it at ~7.2k. I recommend nightly CI load that ramps to 8k for 10m (non-blocking) and a smaller PR-triggered smoke that runs for 2m at 2k.

maya: Proposed action items:
- owner: kevin -> add perf-job (ramp 8k / sustain 10m), add a 2k smoke for PRs, add links to reproducer (due: 2026-04-04)
- owner: sara -> add `kv_prefix_set` prompts (12 items) to regression-evals and a strict comparison flag (due: 2026-03-28)
- owner: tom -> add KV metrics and alert on miss-rate delta > 4% over baseline (due: 2026-03-26)
- owner: maya -> create chaos drill playbook (redis latency + worker kills) and schedule with eng-sre (due: 2026-04-09)

ci-bot: Reminder: add items to the postmortem tracker with tags: regression-test, kv-cache, chaos-drill.

sara: I'll commit prompts under `evaluations/kv/kv_regression_prompts.yaml` and include a small harness that fails CI when `--strict-kv` is set. Will keep file < 1KB.

kevin: Snippet I'll add to perf-suite YAML: 
```
job_name: kv-regression-nightly
ramp_to: 8000
sustain_seconds: 600
avg_seq_len: 80
clients: 120
quantized_matrix: [baseline, fallback]
```

maya: Also: add a path-filter GH workflow so any PR touching `serving/kv*` or `serving/serializer*` triggers the small KV smoke (2k). I'll own that (due: 2026-03-29).

tom: Good idea. Also require developers to run `make kv-local-test` prior to merging; sara can add a Make target that spins a constrained reproducer for ~30s.

sara: Will do. I'll add `make kv-local-test` which runs 30s at ~2k qps against local harness, prints mismatch diffs.

kevin: Question: should the nightly 8k test block merges if it fails? I think no — noisy; but it should create an alert + auto-open a tracking ticket.

tom: Agreed: nightly should not block. Add auto-ticket and label `perf-regression`. Manual gating can be used for release branches.

maya: Chaos drill draft (short):
```
- target: dedicated-serving-pool
- disruptions: add 200ms redis latency; kill 1 worker process for 30s
- iterations: 3 x (5m disruption + 10m recovery)
- success: <1% user errors; fallback variant handles traffic; alerting and runbook followed
- owner: maya
```

ci-bot: Scheduled calendar event: "KV-cache regression drill" 2026-04-10 15:00 UTC.

tom: Pattern note: these regressions line up with small serializer tweaks and rollout of a new quantization build. We should gate serializer changes with an explicit eval.

maya: I'll add a workflow gate: any commits touching `serving/kv*` will trigger the small KV smoke and the prompt-based eval. Owner: maya (due 2026-03-29).

sara: I'll ensure prompts are fast and deterministic; will include a randomized seed section for variety but keep main checks deterministic.

kevin: I'll attach reproducer logs and perf traces to INC-7423 and link the PRs.

tom: Thanks. Quick roll-up checklist: owners + tasks + due dates in tracker, PRs for perf-suite and evals, GH path triggers, chaos drill scheduled. If anyone needs to shift dates, call it out. :thumbsup:

maya: Dates OK from my side.

sara: On track; will ping on PR.

kevin: PR opened in a bit.

tom: Closing thread 1 — I'll update the postmortem tracker to `testing-added` and we'll review after the drill run. Appreciate everyone's fast responses.
